You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. You own exactly: frontend/e2e/blind-player.spec.js (edit), frontend/e2e/merge-blind-player.js (new), frontend/e2e/merge-blind-player.test.js (new). Do NOT edit any other file; import from others. Tests are hermetic node:test; never call the live game, OpenAI or the network, and do NOT run blind-player.spec.js (billed).

BACKGROUND: the L2 @blind-player Playwright test plays 1 to 3 replicates one after another in one test body and always writes artifacts/e2e-blind-player.{json,md}. We want to run each replicate in its own Playwright process in parallel, then merge, so that the existing report shape (and digest.py, which reads it) stays unchanged. Read frontend/e2e/blind-player.spec.js, the exports aggregate and formatMarkdown in frontend/e2e/blind-player.js, and writeCategoryReport in frontend/e2e/helpers.js (it writes artifacts/e2e-<category>.json and .md under the repo root) first.

CHANGE 1, blind-player.spec.js: add env E2E_BLIND_REPLICATE_INDEX. When unset, behaviour is EXACTLY as today (E2E_BLIND_REPLICATES 1 to 3, one report named blind-player). When set, it must be an integer 1 to 3 (otherwise throw a clear error), E2E_BLIND_REPLICATES is ignored, only that one replicate runs, the replicate's `replicate` field is that index (not 1), and the report is written with category `blind-player-r<N>` (so artifacts/e2e-blind-player-r<N>.json). Keep the staging guard, key guard, call cap and everything else untouched. Put the small pure decision (indices to run and the report category from the env value) in an exported function in merge-blind-player.js, for example replicatePlan(env) returning {indices, category}, and use it from the spec, so it is unit-testable.

CHANGE 2, merge-blind-player.js: export mergeReports(reports) taking the parsed per-replicate report objects in order. It throws if the list is empty, if story_id or scene differ, or if a report has no replicates array. It returns {story_id, scene, replicates, aggregate} where replicates is the flat list renumbered 1..N in input order (set each `replicate` field) and aggregate comes from aggregate() in blind-player.js; plus the markdown from formatMarkdown(report) the same way blind-player.spec.js does it. Also add a CLI usable as `node e2e/merge-blind-player.js <artifacts-dir> <count>` (run only when the file is the entry point, so importing it has no side effects): it reads <artifacts-dir>/e2e-blind-player-r1.json .. r<count>.json, and if any is missing or unparsable it prints to stderr which one (naming e.g. r3) and exits 1 without writing anything; otherwise it writes <artifacts-dir>/e2e-blind-player.json and e2e-blind-player.md in the same format writeCategoryReport uses (json: the evidence object including a `markdown` field, 2-space JSON plus newline; md: '# blind-player E2E evaluation' heading plus the fenced json), and exits 0. Count is an integer 1 to 3.

CHANGE 3, merge-blind-player.test.js: tests for replicatePlan (unset gives indices from E2E_BLIND_REPLICATES and category blind-player; index 2 gives [2] and blind-player-r2 and ignores E2E_BLIND_REPLICATES; 0, 4 and abc throw), mergeReports (renumbering, aggregate matches aggregate() over the same runs, scene mismatch throws, empty throws), and the CLI via child_process on a temp dir (success writes both files; a missing r3 exits 1 naming r3 and writes nothing).

HOW TO RUN (worktree root): cd frontend && node --test e2e/*.test.js. If frontend/node_modules is missing: ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules (never npm install). The check also runs the merge CLI on fixture reports and `npx playwright test --list --grep @blind-player`.

OUTPUT: also write ./notes.md at the worktree root (not git-added) with judgment calls.
